item.title: Happy Valley-Goose Bay Tower site lost in fire
item.description: Lighthouse FM was heartbroken to find out that we lost all of our broadcasting equipment at 5 Wing Goose Bay, in the huge fire on Friday, April 19. The blaze had the town declaring a state of emergency. We have to decide what to do next to get back on the air in that community. […]
